motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve the Consent Agenda, removing item 13.A. from the agenda to be discussed at a later date, and to update the minutes from the December 16, 2025, City Council Meeting to reflect that the motion on item 12.A. passed with a 3:0, not a 3:2 vote. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Consent agenda passed, one item pulled
motions.summary: The council approved its routine consent items, pulled item 13.A for a later meeting, and corrected the December 16 minutes to show a 3:0 vote.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 17.60.120 General Fencing/screening provisions
motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 17.60.120 General Fencing/screening provisions. Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: New citywide fence and screening rules
motions.summary: The city rewrote its general fencing and screening rules, changing the standards property owners must meet when putting up fences or screening walls.

motions.item_title: Deny the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange (Minor) Site Plan Amendment
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to deny the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange (Minor) Site Plan Amendment. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.outcome: failed for lack of a majority vote, 2:3.
motions.headline: Bid to reject Hidden Hollow amenity swap
motions.summary: The council weighed flatly rejecting the Hidden Hollow amenity exchange site plan change rather than leaving it tabled for a later look.

motions.item_title: Table the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange (Minor) Site Plan Amendment. Clark seconded the motion
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to table the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange (Minor) Site Plan Amendment. Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Hidden Hollow amenity swap put on hold
motions.summary: The council set aside a proposed change to the Hidden Hollow site plan that would swap out planned amenities, delaying any decision to a later date.

motions.item_title: Appoint Melissa Clark as Mayor Pro Tempore
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to appoint Melissa Clark as Mayor Pro Tempore. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Melissa Clark named mayor pro tempore
motions.summary: The council named Councilmember Melissa Clark as mayor pro tempore, the member who steps in to lead when the mayor is unavailable.
